interpretation_method: right-left shrinks with epsilon for smooth gradients too; extrapolated jump cancels first order. One-sided secants test C1 separately; controls at +16wu also integer interpolation knots. No arbitrary overall PASS. float bilinear at integer coordinates can leave persistent derivative mismatches even when C0 holds.

coast_transects.method: Three fixed shelf transects visually selected from overview; not the exact curved coastline, may mix land heights. Gaussian residual sigma12wu, linear detrend, Hann periodogram; 2wu Nyquist4wu, only report>=6wu; peaks are finite-window bins, not precise physical periods. Trough prominence max(.15Y,.4 std), minimum spacing4wu.
